description: Lists public companies whose SEC filings (8-K, 10-K, 10-Q, S-1) mention AI data licensing, from MON$TER's weekly SEC EDGAR full-text tracker, with filing dates and direct links to each filing on sec.gov. Optionally filter by part of a company name. Use when someone asks which companies license data to AI or wants public examples. A match means a filing mentions the phrases, not that a deal closed or its value.

company_name_contains.description: Optional text to match within company names, e.g. "yelp".

name: list_public_data_licensing_disclosures
title: List public data-licensing disclosures
